product.title: Tetons and Snake River Scenic Float Trip In Jackson Hole

description.text: On this relaxing rafting trip from Jackson Hole, drift down a scenic section of Wyoming's wildlife-laden Snake River, where moose, deer, river otters and eagles can all be seen from your raft. Be sure to bring your camera to photograph any wildlife that appears on the banks, and also capture the stunning landscape extending out from the Tetons.Scenic raft float along the Snake River near Jackson Hole, Wyoming See osprey, bald eagles, moose, deer and river otters as you travel along the river Learn about the history and geology of the Snake River from your knowledgeable guide Admire the beautif Stops include Snake River Canyon, Grand Teton, Dave Hansen Whitewater and Scenic River Trips, Wilson, Gros Ventre Mountains, Bridger Teton National Forest. Transportation, safety gear, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on the landscape. Ideal for travelers basing in Jackson Hole who want a guided Wyoming outing without self-driving mountain roads.
